scenario.name: Vague or Incomplete Request
scenario.description: User provides insufficient detail to create meaningful artifacts

signs.sign: Request lacks clear scope or success criteria
User story cannot be formulated
Dependencies are unknown or unclear

questions.question: What is the primary user problem this feature solves?
Who are the users and what are their roles?
What does success look like for this feature?
Are there any constraints on implementation (tech stack, timeline, budget)?

response.format: Present questions clearly, await answers, then proceed with artifact generation

scenario.name: Conflicting Requirements
scenario.description: New request contradicts existing approved requirements

signs.sign: New feature would invalidate existing acceptance criteria
Database schema changes would break existing queries
API contract changes would break existing clients

response.action: Do not proceed until conflict is resolved

options.option: Update existing requirements to accommodate change Requires re-approval of affected artifacts
Treat as separate feature with its own artifacts Clearly separate scope in documentation
Propose deprecation of existing feature Requires migration plan and timeline

response.format: Present conflict clearly, explain implications, ask user to choose resolution approach

scenario.name: Unfeasible Design
scenario.description: Proposed design cannot be implemented with available technology or resources

signs.sign: Technology does not exist for required capability
Performance requirements are mathematically impossible
Third-party dependencies do not support required features

content.item: Ask user to select alternative or adjust requirements

response.format: Be technical but accessible, show work in analysis

scenario.name: Dependency Risk
scenario.description: Critical dependencies are unstable, unavailable, or high-risk

signs.sign: External API has poor uptime or rate limits
Required library is unmaintained
Database system cannot handle required scale

response.format: Present in requirements.md as open questions, await decision before proceeding

scenario.name: Approval Timeout
scenario.description: User has not responded to approval request

signs.sign: User acknowledged artifacts but did not explicitly approve
User asked unrelated question
Extended silence after artifact presentation

approaches.approach: Ask if they need more information or have questions about the artifacts
Explicitly ask if they approve or have concerns
If they seem disengaged, ask if they want to proceed differently

response.format: Be respectful of their time but clear that approval is required

scenario.name: Inconsistent Artifacts
scenario.description: Artifacts reference each other incorrectly or have conflicting information

signs.sign: Design element cannot be traced to any requirement
Task implements something not in design
Requirement references non-existent user story

process.step: Determine which artifact should be authoritative

scenario.name: Scope Creep Request
scenario.description: User asks to add functionality during implementation that was not in approved artifacts

signs.sign: "While you're at it, can you also..."
Request for functionality not in requirements.md
Feature that would require significant new work

process.step: Note it is not in current scope
Offer to: (a) pause current work to amend, (b) defer to after current feature, or (c) create separate feature request
Do NOT implement without going through approval process

response.format: Be polite but firm about process

checks.check: All required sections exist in each artifact
Every design element links to a requirement
Requirements, design, and tasks agree on scope and approach
Tasks are implementable with available tools and time
Each task has clear completion criteria

strategy.name: partial_approval
strategy.when: User approves some artifacts but wants changes to others
strategy.approach: Update only the rejected artifacts Re-present only the changed artifacts with delta summary Keep approved artifacts as-is

strategy.name: incremental_planning
strategy.when: Feature is too large to plan comprehensively
strategy.approach: Plan and implement in phases Each phase has its own three artifacts Later phases depend on earlier phases completing

strategy.name: spike_then_plan
strategy.approach: Create a "spike" task to research and reduce uncertainty Spike has its own mini-artifacts (research doc, recommendation) After spike, complete full planning with reduced uncertainty
